title: Xcode: set the iPhone's Thermal State to Serious (test profile serious)
instructions: On the Mac, in Xcode choose Window > Devices and Simulators, click Devices and select the iPhone; under Device Conditions set Condition to Thermal State and Profile to Serious, then click Start. Leave it on (keep the cable in: it ends when the phone disconnects from Xcode). The serious profile wants the phone at Serious induced by Xcode. Then click Done here; fix-scrollcb-g0 runs again.
